name: Cedar Foods Group
summary: Manufacturer of packaged Mediterranean food products for regional and export markets.
description: Cedar Foods Group produces a full range of packaged Mediterranean staples, including olive oil, preserves, and canned goods, distributed across the Middle East, Europe, and West Africa. The company operates two production facilities in Mount Lebanon and holds ISO 22000 and HACCP certification.

name: Levant Textile Mills
summary: Vertically integrated textile manufacturer specializing in woven fabrics and finished garments.
description: Levant Textile Mills operates a vertically integrated production line from yarn to finished garment, supplying private-label apparel to retailers across Europe and the Gulf. The company invests heavily in sustainable dyeing processes and water reclamation.

name: Beirut Precision Metals
summary: CNC machining and precision metal fabrication for industrial and automotive clients.
description: Beirut Precision Metals delivers CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, and custom tooling for automotive, aerospace-adjacent, and industrial equipment manufacturers. The facility runs 24/7 production cycles and holds ISO 9001:2015 certification.

name: Nahr Plastics & Packaging
summary: Injection-molded packaging and flexible film production for the food and consumer goods sectors.
description: Nahr Plastics & Packaging supplies injection-molded containers, closures, and flexible packaging film to food processors and consumer goods brands across the Levant. Recent investment in recycled-content resin lines supports clients' sustainability targets.

name: Mount Lebanon Building Materials
summary: Producer of cement blocks, tiles, and finishing materials for residential and commercial construction.
description: Mount Lebanon Building Materials manufactures concrete blocks, ceramic tiles, and construction finishing products supplied to contractors across Lebanon and the broader Levant region. The company operates its own quarry and aggregate processing plant.

name: Phoenicia Renewable Energy Systems
summary: Designer and assembler of solar power systems and energy storage solutions for industrial sites.
description: Phoenicia Renewable Energy Systems designs, assembles, and installs solar photovoltaic systems and battery storage solutions for industrial and commercial facilities, helping manufacturers reduce grid dependency amid Lebanon's energy constraints.
